messages.english: The catalogue describes the Soil Survey Complex as a digital compilation of historic surveys made at different map scales.
The catalogue links Open Government Licence – Ontario for this record. Its attribution requirements apply to reuse.
Use the provider’s specified credit and link to the licence where possible. The licence gives default wording for cases without a specific credit or where multiple credits are impractical.
Coverage and map scale vary. Individual layers, downloadable data and field conditions need separate verification.
